demos.title: Manual tuning
demos.prompt: a smooth ceramic vase on a white plinth, editorial product photograph, hand painted teal coral graphite accents, clean unmarked surface, soft studio light
demos.lesson: Manual mode lets the user decide exactly what the image contributes. This demo borrows palette and finish without borrowing the abstract source shapes.

demos.title: Balanced
demos.prompt: a refined editorial product photograph of a sculptural table lamp on a simple wooden surface, calm neutral background, clean design, no readable text
demos.lesson: Balanced treats the reference as a general visual guide: subject, layout, color, and finish can all speak in a moderate way.

demos.title: Keep the same subject
demos.prompt: the same cone-shaped sculptural table lamp redesigned as a premium ceramic product, editorial studio photo, soft shadows, no readable text
demos.lesson: Use this when the product, character, outfit, or main object must stay recognizable while the prompt changes material or styling.

demos.title: Copy pose and layout
demos.prompt: four small ceramic fragrance bottles arranged on a diagonal display shelf, refined product photography, warm gallery light, no readable text
demos.lesson: This recipe borrows camera angle, spacing, crop, and broad placement while suppressing identity and texture from the reference.

demos.title: Copy lighting and mood
demos.prompt: a spherical glass desk lamp on a dark blue tabletop, dramatic warm side beam, cinematic shadow, minimal editorial product photo, no readable text
demos.lesson: Use this when you like the light direction, contrast, haze, glow, or atmosphere, but do not want the reference object copied exactly.

demos.title: Suggest the visual style
demos.prompt: a modern table lamp in a clean studio product photo, teal coral graphite art direction, abstract editorial styling, no readable text
demos.lesson: The style recipe borrows palette, finish, medium, and atmosphere while trying not to copy the style image subject.

demos.title: Suggest material or texture
demos.prompt: a handcrafted ceramic table lamp with woven black-and-cream surface texture, editorial product photo, clean unmarked design
demos.lesson: Use this for surface feel: paper grain, ceramic weave, brushed metal, fabric, stone, paint finish, or other material cues.

demos.title: Copy big shapes only
demos.prompt: a black sculptural perfume bottle with a bold triangular silhouette on a plinth, luxury product photo, minimal background, no readable text
demos.lesson: Shape-only mode is for silhouette, massing, and broad geometry. It intentionally removes palette, texture, and fine detail influence.

demos.title: Avoid copying text/logos
demos.prompt: a clean gallery sign on a simple stand with a smooth blank center panel, plain unmarked surface, no readable words, no letters, no logo, soft daylight
demos.lesson: Text/logo guard turns signs, labels, UI, and brand marks into blank shape guidance instead of asking the model to reproduce lettering.
